target: Render auditable daily message and Codex-reported token volume as an all-trusted-device total with a nested local-device subset.
primary_semantics: The Memory Plane derives daily telemetry, the Exchange Plane carries immutable read-only token-ledger revisions, and the Product Shell renders only trusted replicas already synchronized to the current device.
trigger: Dashboard status generation and an already-enabled federation export or import.
scope: Local archive plus one read-only replica for each currently trusted peer node.
parameters_and_defaults: Fourteen visible days, Asia/Tokyo day boundary, messages selected by default, 24-hour stale threshold.
required_actions: Deduplicate by origin node and message/session identity, expose token coverage and freshness, retain local and per-device drilldown values.
evidence_and_validation: Protocol v1 read compatibility, protocol v2 telemetry exchange, reset-aware daily token tests, trusted-peer aggregation, UI syntax and three-locale browser rehearsal, full release suite and same-SHA CI.
failure_and_escalation: Exclude revoked peers, mark missing token telemetry incomplete, mark old or missing sync stale, and never substitute character estimates for reported tokens.
exit_and_lifecycle: The feature may be removed by reverting the derived UI and protocol-v2 telemetry reader; append-only raw history and imported read-only replicas remain valid.
invariants: Raw messages, summaries, indexes, and existing replica artifacts remain append-only and are never rewritten or deleted.
All-devices means the local node plus each currently trusted peer replica exactly once; it never claims account-global completeness.
Reported tokens are derived only from Codex token_count telemetry and are never estimated from characters.
Missing or stale peer telemetry is visible and is not converted into a zero-valued proof of complete coverage.
Protocol v2 accepts v1 bundles; token telemetry is an optional v2 artifact and never becomes retrieval authority.
v3.0 remains prohibited without the separately approved incompatible-contract gate.
allowed_changes: Add reset-aware daily_usage to derived token ledgers and force a bounded v2 telemetry backfill.
Exchange immutable, path-sanitized token-ledger revisions through federation protocol v2.
Add a read-only federated daily aggregation module and dashboard projection.
Add nested bars, message/token switching, freshness warnings, and device drilldown in three locales.
prohibited_changes: Rewrite source rollouts or authoritative raw archive records to obtain daily metrics.
Aggregate revoked, unknown, or duplicate peer roots.
Expose source filesystem paths inside exchanged token telemetry.
Label estimates, summaries, or partial replicas as Codex-reported account totals.
before_after_checks: Prove a counter reset is assigned once to the correct Asia/Tokyo day.
Prove duplicate telemetry revisions resolve to one latest session ledger.
Prove revoked peers are excluded and stale trusted peers remain visible as stale.
Import a v1 bundle and exchange a v2 token telemetry artifact without changing raw messages.
Render desktop and mobile charts in Chinese, English, and Japanese with no overlap or blank state.
